execution: serial fresh CPU process per seed, after all isolated inference timings complete
timed_scope: one unchanged frozen calibrate(table, tokens) call: initial INT4 encoding, causal INT4 rollout, residual covariance, eigensolver, and mixed-channel scoring
excluded_from_timer: model and source loading, input generation, token table construction and validation, reference loading, array comparison, hashing, and file I/O
storage_report: sum of returned NumPy stats arrays' nbytes; stats storage only, not peak temporary/allocator memory
comparison: compare every returned array with original calibration.npz; report byte equality, dtype/shape and actual differences; never replace primary arrays or codecs
